title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-prep-jul-2026-ethan-personal-notes
content:
Meeting: Cross-functional roadmap alignment (Product + Eng + Applied ML) - prep notes
Date: 2026-07-29 weekly sync (30m)
Owner/Prep by: Ethan Park (product)
Attendees (expected): Maya Patel (eng - serving runtime), Raj Singh (applied ML), Asha Kumar (product PM), +2 leads from SRE & Console (optional)
Objectives for sync:
- Align on Q3 priorities that impact inference serving: batching/kv-cache work, model-onboarding flow, and rollout windows for Dedicated customers.
- Surface open risks from Applied ML experiments (quantization regressions) that might block rollouts.
- Agree on action items and owners for cross-team dependencies over next 2 sprints.
Agenda (30m)
1) 0-5m: Quick context + success criteria for this sync (Ethan)
   - Reduce cross-team blockers for model onboarding and rollout by 50% month-over-month.
   - Identify any changes that will move planned Dedicated customer rollouts beyond their SLA dates.
2) 5-12m: Eng update (Maya)
   - Current status: batching v2 can hit target throughput on internal perf tests but increases median p99 latency by ~30ms for short sequences.
   - ETA for canary: 2 weeks if we only run perf/flake fixes; 4 weeks if we include hot-path kernel changes.
   - Ask: Need Applied ML to validate quality on quantized 4-bit models for the top 3 customer workloads (RINF-1024).
3) 12-20m: Applied ML update (Raj)
   - Running evaluation harness on quantized variants; early drift for code-generation prompts on model-x-3b at sequence lengths >1024.
   - Hypothesis: KV-cache + continuous batching interactions causing subtle context truncation in current shim; will run focused regression tests.
   - Ask: Eng to provide reproducible perf configs and small dataset from production-like prompts (anonymized) to reproduce drift.
4) 20-27m: Product constraints & customer commitments (Asha/Ethan)
   - Two Dedicated customers (AcmeHealth, Finlytics) expect rollout by 2026-08-15. If we delay, risk loss of committed revenue.
   - Discuss temporary mitigations: pin older model variant for those customers + traffic shaping.
5) 27-30m: Actions, owners, and quick blockers check (Ethan)
Key talking points to raise if asked:
- Tradeoffs: throughput vs median latency — metric to keep: p95 should not exceed 120ms for short prompt profiles for Hosted tier. If batching v2 pushes p95 >120ms we should gate on Dedicated-only rollout.
- Regression risk: Applied ML should produce an "eval diff" with at least 3 prompt families and per-prompt token-level divergence and human-eval notes.
Open questions to resolve in sync:
- Which customer rollouts can we safely delay without contractual penalties? (Asha to confirm with CSMs)
- Can Eng produce a reproducible test harness (perf+functional) by 2026-08-03? (Maya)
follow_up_actions:
Action 1: Raj to run focused regression tests on quantized model-x-3b (task RINF-1189) and upload eval diffs by 2026-08-02. Owner: Raj Singh.
Action 2: Maya to provide reproducible perf configs and a small anonymized prompt set for Applied ML by 2026-08-03. Owner: Maya Patel.
Action 3: Ethan/Asha to talk to CSMs about which customer rollouts can be delayed and confirm by 2026-07-30. Owner: Asha Kumar & Ethan Park.
Action 4: Temporary mitigation plan: Product to propose traffic shaping/pinned-model plan for AcmeHealth by 2026-08-01; Eng to estimate effort. Owner: Ethan Park / Maya Patel.
Action 5: Create a short confluence follow-up with summary & decision log after the sync. Owner: Ethan. Due: 2026-07-30.
notes_to_self:
- Keep the sync tight; escalate only if Raj's regressions breach our threshold.
- If Eng asks to delay, highlight contractual risk and revenue impact.
- Bring up metric collection gap: we don't currently capture per-customer per-model p95 on dedicated clusters in the console; flag to Observability.
- Follow up with SRE on required logging for reproducing the issue (trace ids + sample payloads).
- Remember to attach eval diff template in Confluence page linked above.
